blocks.text: Professional wrestling star Jermaine Haley, known to his fans as Bronson Reed, has died aged 38, World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) said Friday. His death comes weeks after he competed in a match against Oba Femi at the Crown Jewel event in Saudi Arabia’s capital Riyadh. WWE said it was “devastated to announce that Jermaine Haley, also known as Bronson Reed, passed away earlier today at the age of 38 due to medical complications,” in an X post.
